provenance.what: One canonical Shellbox rollout batch with eight multi-turn tasks and a SkyRL optimizer update.
provenance.produced_by: A Marin RL artifact main, followed by ci/marin_nightly/gate.py.
why_these_thresholds: All eight tasks must complete at least two model turns. Aggregate turn counts alone cannot prove this.
The canonical engine rejects changed token prefixes and token/logprob length mismatches. Generated tokens must have behavior logprobs.
Failed trajectories and skipped TIS batches must remain zero. The final optimizer loss must be finite.
provenance.cost: The launch artifact controls GPU topology and sandbox count. The elapsed-time limit is 2400 seconds.
